nodes.author: AponiaAnalytics
nodes.text:
🟠Health workers at Jakarta’s Soekarno-Hatta and Halim Perdanakusuma Airports have increased monitoring to prevent the spread of human metapneumovirus (#HMPV). 
#hMPV #China #India @CDCgov #Indonesia

nodes.author: AponiaAnalytics
nodes.text:
🟠Thermal scanners are being used at international arrival gates, and passengers must fill out the Satu Sehat Health Pass (#SSHP) app, which assigns #risk status based on symptoms, travel history, and contacts.
#hMPV #China #India @CDCgov #Indonesia

nodes.author: AponiaAnalytics
nodes.text:
🟠Passengers flagged as red (showing symptoms) or orange (close contacts) undergo further checks at health posts or laboratories at the airports. 
So far, no #HMPV cases have been reported at either #airport.
#hMPV #China #India @CDCgov #Indonesia
